summary: Full Stack Developer with over a year of professional experience building business systems and digital products end to end. My core stack is Astro, React, Node.js, and .NET, with SQL for data modeling. I apply Clean Architecture, SOLID, and microservices across transactional domains — finance, accounting, and logistics — as well as user-facing experiences, turning complex requirements into maintainable, measurable solutions.

experiences.role: Full Stack Developer for Grupo Monge

Redesigned MARKET-APP in Electron and React, turning an early prototype into a production-ready self-service tool with i18n support.
Implemented a real-time messaging system with Angular and Firebase, with instant notifications and chat management between candidates and recruiters, removing email-based coordination.
Refactored Python backend middlewares to integrate API Key authentication, enabling concurrent validation of OAuth and JWT tokens across roughly 25 endpoints.
Created the company's first website with Astro, Tailwind CSS, and Figma, achieving 95+ on all three Google Lighthouse scores: performance, SEO, and accessibility.
Designed and implemented an ERP in Blazor and .NET to centralize inventory management across multiple warehouses nationwide, also executing its deployment.
Digitized and automated stock management, replacing physical forms and Excel sheets with a real-time SQL Server system that cut request processing time by 80%.
Built an automated reporting module in Blazor for quarterly audits, eliminating manual consolidation and enabling PDF and Excel export in one click.
